OF1 Discovery Report

breathe-app.com

Site discovery and demo proposal for the OF1 personalization experience.

Site Overview

Purpose
Marketing site for Breathe, a free breathing/meditation app for iOS and Android
Product Lines
Single product — Breathe app with 8 background atmospheres and 4+ breathing rhythm presets
Audience
Health-conscious mobile users seeking simple, distraction-free mindfulness tools
Brand Tone
Calm, minimal, confident — "Everything you need, nothing you don't."

Proposed Demo

Focus

Breathing techniques and background atmospheres — personalized session recommendations based on user intent (stress relief, sleep, energy, focus).

Narrative

Maya, 32 — Product Manager

Dealing with afternoon stress and occasional insomnia. She's heard breathing exercises help but doesn't know which technique or atmosphere to choose. She visits breathe-app.com looking for guidance.

The OF1 experience surfaces a personalized recommendation: "Based on your interest in winding down after work, try the 4/7/8 Sleep rhythm with the Fireplace background for a 5-minute evening session." This converts her from browser to downloader.

Key Pages to Reproduce

  • https://breathe-app.com/ — Homepage (hero, capabilities, backgrounds, rhythms, download CTA)
  • https://breathe-app.com/#capabilities — Capabilities section (6-feature grid)
  • https://breathe-app.com/#backgrounds — Backgrounds section (8 atmosphere cards)

Why This Works

Breathe offers distinct product dimensions (rhythms x backgrounds x duration) that map perfectly to personalization intents. A stressed user needs different guidance than someone seeking morning energy. OF1 can intelligently recommend the right combination — turning a browse into a confident download decision.

Page Structure

Homepage

01Header — Logo + nav (Home, Capabilities, Support, Privacy) + language switcher (27 langs) + "Get the app" CTA pill
02Hero — "iOS & Android" badge + H1 "Find your calm in minutes" + subheadline + App Store/Play badges + phone mockup (Advanced settings screen)
03Capabilities — H2 "Everything you need, nothing you don't" + 6-card grid (background carousel, rhythm carousel, start button, offline-first, advanced options, 27 languages)
04Backgrounds — H2 + horizontal carousel of 8 atmosphere cards (Beach, River, Fireplace, Earth, Space as VIDEO; Seashore, Countryside, Rainforest as IMAGE)
05Breathing Rhythms — H2 + animated inhale/exhale visualization + 4 preset cards (Balance 5/5, Relax 4/6, Energy 6/4, Sleep 4/7/8)
06Download CTA — H2 "Take a breath. The good kind." + green CTA button "Get Breathe — it's free"
07Footer — Logo + nav links + "© 2026 Breathe · Available in 27 languages"

Support (/support/)

01Contact — Email address for bugs, feedback, questions
02Donate — App is free and ad-free; optional donation to sustain development
03Cross-promo — RankingsHub (sibling sports rankings app)
